report.explanation: All 12 gateway checkout observations returned HTTP 200 with durations 47-297ms; traces show successful order, inventory, payment, and postgres spans with no errors. Metrics show zero 502s on /v1/checkout. No fault is established by current evidence; the p95 of 412ms is a single-route aggregate without a baseline. Operator hypothesis of a fault is contradicted by healthy telemetry, so hand off.
missing_evidence: Baseline latency distribution for /v1/checkout to judge whether 412ms p95 is anomalous
